scripts.isolation-check: grep -r 'AKASHPORTFOLIO\|control-room\|akashportfolio' apps/ services/ --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' --include='*.rs' && echo 'FAIL: isolation violated' || echo 'OK: isolation clean'
